contract: W6 destructive-lifecycle subset: backup create/retention/upload/apply, collection and playlist batch operations, item repeat-delete, library-delete file/record cascades, persisted database snapshots, and selected live Socket.IO events.

invariants.contract: Database snapshots remain compatible through item deletion, library deletion, and backup restore; repeat item deletion returns the upstream outcome and preserves the expected rows/files.
Applying a backup preserves the authenticated live Socket.IO connection and emits backup_applied after restore; selected cascade event names are captured on real sockets.

evidence: go-backend/contracts/parity/cascades-differential-report.json (fresh independent fixture run: nine response scenarios and persisted snapshots, zero divergences)
exceptions: Rapid backup filenames have minute granularity; this run compared cross-side counts/lifecycle, but distinct-file retention rolloff under a controlled clock is not established.
Socket evidence covers selected W6 lifecycle windows only; it is not a complete event recipient/payload inventory.
